sloka: निवर्त्तयितुकामस्तु त्वामेतद्वाक्यमुक्तवान् ।इमां लोकसमुत्पत्तिं लोकनाथ निबोध मे ॥ २.११०.२॥
transliteration: nivarttayitukāmastu tvāmetadvākyamuktavān ।imāṁ lokasamutpattiṁ lokanātha nibodha me ॥ 2.110.2॥

translations.english: O lord of the worlds, Jabali had spoken all this only with the intention to make you return (to Ayodhya). Listen I shall (now) relate to you the origin of the world.
